description.value: The BCLIQUOR store at Broadway and Lillooet is one of 198 government-operated retail outlets run by BC's Liquor Distribution Branch, stocking an extensive range of wine, beer, spirits, coolers, and ciders. Knowledgeable staff offer food, wine, and beverage pairing recommendations, and the chain operates Signature stores with expanded fine wine and premium spirits selections. As a provincial retail chain, it accepts all major payment methods including cash, debit, Visa, Mastercard, and American Express.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the BCLIQUOR Broadway & Lillooet location (store #300), consistent with the OSM address at 3150 East Broadway; the store locator page is active with no closure indicators. No cycling-specific amenities—bike parking, washrooms, or water refill—are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags. The website does not list a store-specific phone number (only head office and customer service lines appear), so the OSM phone cannot be corroborated.
concerns: Category 'Food & Drink' is a loose fit — this is an alcohol retail store, not a food or café establishment.
OSM phone +1-604-660-0604 cannot be confirmed via website; only head office (604-252-7400) and customer service (1-866-225-4968) numbers are listed.
No required WWC criteria are confirmed; on-site verification needed before any listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: None of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from website or OSM tags, making accreditation impossible without an in-person visit; the category match is also weak for a cycling tourism directory.

provenance.category_correction_reason: This is an alcohol retail store; 'Shopping' or 'Retail' would be a more accurate category than 'Food & Drink'.
